title: Musher Listing Document
description: The catalog storefront entry for a blueprint or component.
$comment: Structural and type validation only — cross-document reference resolution, slug/directory agreement, and platform capability checks are separate validation layers. See spec.md.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Must be LISTING.

specVersion.description: Version of the Musher specification this document is written against.

ListingMetadata.description: Identity block of a listing document. A listing names the item it presents and carries no revision of its own; the item's revision is the blueprint's. See spec.md §3.

slug.description: Item slug — must equal the item's directory name.

ListingScreenshot.description: One storefront screenshot declared as a relative media path.

caption.description: Accessible caption shown beneath the screenshot. Omitted when none.

file.$comment: Lookahead-free so it compiles under RE2 as well as ECMA-262. A segment must begin with a letter or digit, which is how `.` and `..` are excluded without a negative lookahead; the extension alternation is spelled in character classes because a JSON Schema pattern carries no case-insensitive flag. See spec.md §5.
file.description: Path of the screenshot asset under the item's media/ directory, relative to the item root. Must be a .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp below media/.

ListingSpec.description:
The `spec` block of a listing document — how the item is presented,
categorised, and discovered on the storefront.

Identity lives in `metadata`, not here. `icon` and `screenshots[].file` are
media paths, resolved inside the item root and required to begin with
`media/`.

category.description: Storefront category the listing is browsed under.

description.description: Long-form Markdown storefront description. Omitted when none.

displayName.description: Storefront title shown to prospective installers.

homepageURL.description: Project homepage URL. Omitted when none. Must use the https, http, or mailto scheme, in any case.
homepageURL.$comment: Anchored and lookahead-free, so it compiles under RE2 as well as ECMA-262 and cannot be driven to backtrack. The scheme set is spec.md §4.1's, applied to a field that carries a URL directly rather than inside Markdown. The scheme alternation is spelled in character classes because a JSON Schema pattern carries no case-insensitive flag, and RFC 3986 §3.1 makes the scheme case-insensitive — the same reason the media path alternation is spelled that way. Without it this pattern would reject an upper-case scheme the description half of the same rule accepts.

icon.description: Path of the listing's icon under the item's media/ directory (e.g. media/icon.png), relative to the item root. Omitted for no icon.
icon.$comment: The same grammar ListingScreenshot.file carries; see the note there.

itemType.$comment: spec.md §3. BLUEPRINT if and only if the item root holds blueprint.yaml — a semantic rule, because it reads the item root rather than the document.
itemType.description: Shape of the catalog item this listing presents: BLUEPRINT (a composition) or COMPONENT (a single building block).

license.$comment: spec.md §4 / ADR 0003 §2 and §4. The shape is this contract's and the membership is SPDX's, published at https://spdx.org/licenses/ and deliberately not restated. Flat: a parenthesised expression is outside this grammar, which spec.md §9 records. Anchored and lookahead-free, so it compiles under RE2 as well as ECMA-262.
license.description: SPDX licence expression for the listed software, such as MIT or Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception. Omitted when unspecified.

lifecycleStage.description: Maturity stage shown on the storefront: STABLE, BETA, EXPERIMENTAL, or SUNSET.

screenshots.description: Storefront screenshots in display order, declared as media paths. At most twelve.

sourceRepoURL.description: Source repository URL. Omitted when none. Must use the https, http, or mailto scheme, in any case.
sourceRepoURL.$comment: The same grammar homepageURL carries; see the note there.

summary.description: One-line storefront tagline summarising the listing.

supportURL.description: Support or documentation URL. Omitted when none. Must use the https, http, or mailto scheme, in any case.
supportURL.$comment: The same grammar homepageURL carries; see the note there. mailto: is in the set for this field in particular — a support address is a plausible value.

tags.description: Free-form discovery tags applied to the listing. At most sixteen, and a tag may not repeat.

items.$comment: spec.md §4 / ADR 0007 §4. A tag is lowercase kebab and is compared after normalisation, so the grammar is what makes two spellings of one tag impossible rather than merely discouraged.
